ImageDescription.value: Baidyabati, Hooghly, India - December 31, 2024: The Baidyabati DVC Canal, nestled 35 kilometers from Kolkata, is a serene retreat blending natural beauty with recreational charm. Known for its appeal as a bird-watching haven and a beloved picnic spot, the canal area comes alive during the year-end season. Families and nature enthusiasts gather here to bask in the tranquility, capturing moments amidst scenic landscapes. The region, rich in avian diversity, offers visitors a unique opportunity to connect with nature. (Photo: Biswarup Ganguly).
